caseNameFull: Shaffer, Indenture Trustees v. Anderson, Trustee in Reorganization
attorneys: M. James Spitzer for petitioners. Harry N. Boureau for respondent. Solicitor General Cox, Peter A. Dammann and David Ferber for the Securities and Exchange Commission. Malcolm S. Mason and Irwin L. Langbein for the Protective Committee.

opinions.text: Motion to correct and amend title to show the Protective Committee for Independent Stockholders of TMT Trailer Ferry, Inc., as a party respondent granted. Petition for writ of cer-tiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit denied.
